Both snapshots carry the same subject_id (atlas-runner) and lineage_id (atlas-release), so they describe the same product lineage; identity is based on these explicit identifiers, not name similarity. As of the most recent supplied snapshot (the 1.1 release notes), the current supported limit is 16 concurrent jobs (atlas-release-2). The 8-job figure remains historically valid as a statement about version 1.0 specifically (atlas-release-1). Unresolved: no snapshots after 1.1 exist in the record, so any later changes to the limit are unknown; no release dates are provided, so chronology rests on version numbering alone; and nothing indicates whether the limit varies by configuration or edition.
